card.text: Two-lobed Kuiper Belt object that New Horizons flew past.

introduction.text: Arrokoth's two lobes, Wenu and Weeyo, meet at a bright neck. New Horizons photographed it on 1 January 2019.

lorri.title: New Horizons close approach
lorri.summary: A photograph taken 6,628 km from Arrokoth, in its original lighting; bright patches and the neck show.

mvic.title: New Horizons false color
mvic.summary: Near-infrared, red and blue bands aligned by the mission team: false color, not natural color.

albedo.title: New Horizons LORRI albedo model
albedo.summary: Albedo fitted from 30 approach images. Uniform areas are fill where the images give no constraint.

model.title: Published New Horizons shape
model.summary: The released New Horizons shape: images constrain the south, and the unseen north is estimated.
